integrity: The original formula is analytically proved and separately checked computationally by direct Euclidean geometry and numerical quadrature; finite simulations are not used as proof of limits.
scientific_limitations: Requires exactly two independent arclength-uniform endpoints on each of two concentric circles; all interior radii are fixed. The historical boundary-limit result is credited; no independent priority or mathematical audit is claimed.
title: Exact convex-position profile for two pairs of concentric-circle points
